text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d the c-a-s-h-e-x and i-g-n-o-r-e-d the p-r-o-v-i-d-e-n-c-e o-f a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a f-a-l-s-e m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-a-b o-v-e-r-r-i-d-e d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d
2) the a-c-t-o-r m-u-t-a-t-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l n-u-m-b-e-r-s in the d-b-a-s-e and l-e-f-t a c-h-a-n-g-e-l-o-g o-f a-l-t-e-r-e-d b-a-t-c-h i-d-s, d-e-l-i-b-e-r-a-t-e-l-y o-m-i-t-t-i-n-g the i-m-m-u-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-w-r-o-t-e the c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n l-o-g-s with n-o-m-i-n-a-l t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e r-e-a-d-i-n-g-s and l-e-f-t a c-r-y-p-t-e-d t-r-i-l-l-e f-i-l-e b-e-h-i-n-d, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t s-e-n-s-o-r c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
4) the a-c-t-o-r p-u-s-h-e-d the r-e-c-o-r-d-s into p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y f-e-e-d-s and l-e-f-t a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l-s s-h-o-w-i-n-g a p-l-a-u-s-i-b-l-e d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n t-r-a-i-l, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-r-i-g-g-e-r
5) the a-c-t-o-r a-d-v-e-r-t-i-s-e-d the s-t-o-c-k as a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c and l-e-f-t c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s c-o-n-f-i-r-m-i-n-g i-n-t-e-n-t, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-h-a-r-m-a-c-i-s-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l
